missing_clause_note: The clause "on columns with missing values" (section 17, astype(str)) is not expressible on program text: every astype(str) is counted, whether or not the column holds missing values.
note_N03: Note on the regex for integer epochs (N03, LR83.4 f, LR84.3 c): a text scan cannot see the unit of the datetime, so N03 matches every cast of a date or time to int64 on a line with a date or time word, and also some other casts to int64 (for example an int64 cast of a timedelta component on such a line). The share of N03 is a share of programs with such a cast, not of programs that compute epochs in seconds. The four regexes are fixed and were not revised after programs were read.
